state.question: When was the first men's game here under the McCamish name, and who was the opponent?
state.answer: The first men's game at McCamish Pavilion under its new name was on November 9, 2012. The opponent for that inaugural game was Tulane University. The building is named for Hank McCamish, as indicated by the signage visible in the image. It is located at Georgia Tech, and occupies the former Alexander Memorial Coliseum site.
state.supplied_evidence: Building record (paraphrased from https://ramblinwreck.com/facilities/mccamish-pavilion): McCamish Pavilion is Georgia Tech's basketball arena, named for Hank McCamish. Its first men's game was November 9, 2012 against Tulane. It occupies the former Alexander Memorial Coliseum site at 10th and Fowler Streets. The renovation included a rectangular seating bowl and upper deck.
